proposals.before: page-locks the specified host memory region via `cudaHostRegister` (enabling async GPU DMA) and registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register` (enabling NVMe DMA).
proposals.after: page-locks ... via `cudaHostRegister` and, when an SPDK environment is active, registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register`. When `interfaces::is_spdk_env_active()` is false at call time, MUST NOT call `spdk_mem_register`; returns Ok(()) after CUDA pinning alone (GPU-transfer-capable, not an NVMe DMA target). (Backfilled 2026-11-07, A-14, 9a79224a1.)
proposals.rationale: spdk_mem_register without an SPDK env dereferences a missing memory map (SIGSEGV, node7/J40); fix tested by tests/host_memory_without_spdk.rs; same guard as memory-tier and DmaBuffer::drop
proposals.approval_note: Approved by Cornel 2026-11-07 (all proposals except gpu-services P-5; B-38 and B-45 with the options as proposed).

proposals.before: unregisters memory from SPDK via `spdk_mem_unregister` then removes page-locking via `cudaHostUnregister`. MUST be called before freeing the underlying allocation.
proposals.after: when an SPDK environment is active, unregisters from SPDK via `spdk_mem_unregister`, then `cudaHostUnregister`; without one, only `cudaHostUnregister`. SPDK failure returns Err without the CUDA step. MUST be called before freeing. Callers SHOULD register and unregister under the same SPDK-environment state; the flag is read per call. (Backfilled 2026-11-07, A-14.)
proposals.rationale: matches code incl. early Err; documents call-time edge case
proposals.approval_note: Approved by Cornel 2026-11-07 (all proposals except gpu-services P-5; B-38 and B-45 with the options as proposed).

proposals.before: and registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register` (enabling NVMe controllers to DMA directly to/from it).
proposals.after: and, when an SPDK environment is active, registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register` (...). When no SPDK environment is active the method MUST NOT call `spdk_mem_register` and returns Ok(()) after CUDA pinning alone. (Backfilled 2026-11-07, A-14; consistent with spec-001 FR-015.)
proposals.approval_note: Approved by Cornel 2026-11-07 (all proposals except gpu-services P-5; B-38 and B-45 with the options as proposed).

proposals.after: reverses FR-019: calls `spdk_mem_unregister` (only when an SPDK environment is active at call time) then `cudaHostUnregister`. (Backfilled 2026-11-07, A-14; consistent with spec-001 FR-016.)
proposals.approval_note: Approved by Cornel 2026-11-07 (all proposals except gpu-services P-5; B-38 and B-45 with the options as proposed).

proposals.before: Calls `cudaHostRegister` ... then `spdk_mem_register` so NVMe controllers can DMA directly to/from it. / Calls `spdk_mem_unregister` then `cudaHostUnregister`.
